title: id_effect platform scorecard
description: Structure of docs/scorecard/scorecard.json (METHOD.md). scripts/scorecard.sh --validate enforces this schema with jq, plus the cross references a schema cannot express: row ids are unique, every row's group is a groups[].id, every row's track is a tracks key, every group has at least one row, frameworks[0] is id_effect and competitor_order lists the other frameworks in order; on a row with checks (method v2, METHOD.md §7), check ids are unique and start with "<row id>#", v2.level and v2.met cover exactly the frameworks (id_effect: exactly its score versions), and v2.met, v2.evidence and v2.notes name only known check ids and frameworks; a non_goal row has no targets, a group keeps at least one row that is not a non-goal, a row keeps at least one check that is not a non-goal, and id_effect meets no non-goal check (method 2.2, METHOD.md §3.3).

method_version.description: METHOD.md version the scores follow (e.g. "2.0"). From 2.0 the stored scores are checklist scores and each row keeps method 1.1 in v1 (METHOD.md §7.4); from 2.2 they leave out non-goal checks (METHOD.md §3.3).

frameworks.description: The 11 columns; the first is id_effect, then the competitors in competitor_order.

tracks.description: Track id -> name; rows[].track references a key.

competitor_order.description: Framework ids that rows[].competitors[i] score, in order.

adr.description: Optional. Version (x.y.z) -> why the id_effect score may drop by 5 or more at that release (scorecard.sh --diff; PLAN-OF-PLANS §7.3).

non_goal.description: Optional (method 2.2). The row is a non-goal: weight 0, it leaves its group mean, U, E, RT and the row KPIs for every framework, and has no targets (METHOD.md §3.3).

process.description: Optional. A process row (project policy, not a library capability): each framework's level is production when it meets a check, absent otherwise (METHOD.md §7.4, method 2.1).

v1.description: Method 2.x only: the method 1.1 history of the row (scripts/scorecard.sh --method 1; METHOD.md §7.4). Its id_effect scores a subset of the row's id_effect versions (the history stops at 0.7.0).

checks.description: Method v2 table-stakes checks (METHOD.md §7). Ids are unique and start with "<row id>#". A row with checks needs v2.

non_goal.description: Optional (method 2.2). The check is a non-goal: it leaves the row's checklist for every framework, so the row scores over its other checks (METHOD.md §3.3). Never set on a check id_effect meets.

v2.description: Method v2 assessment (METHOD.md §7). level and met have an entry for every framework id; id_effect's entries are objects keyed by exactly the versions of the row's id_effect scores. met lists only ids from checks.

evidence.description: Check id -> where id_effect meets it (path, symbol or test).

notes.description: Optional. Framework id -> why its v2 score differs from v1 (REPORT-method-v2.md).

level.description: Method v2 maturity level; its cap is METHOD.md §3.2 (absent 9, labs 39, published 49, tested 69, documented 89, production 100).

nonGoal.description: A non-goal marker (METHOD.md §3.3): set only by a locked decision of PLAN-OF-PLANS §3.1, named by its id.
